title: Control versus treatment data plot

intent.message: Treatment increases the measured concentration relative to the control, with a statistically significant difference.

claims.statement: Treatment increases concentration relative to the control.
The difference between groups is significant at p < 0.01.

expected_design_characteristics: A shared y-axis and scale across both groups
Direct group labeling instead of a detached legend
Error bars with a declared statistic and sample size
Significance annotation placed clear of data and axis labels
known_failure_modes: Truncated y-axis exaggerating the treatment effect
Groups distinguished by color alone without a second channel
Error bars shown without a stated statistic or n
